title: Reijin's Life System
description: This project give you a life system
body:
With this datapack you can have a life system, every people start with 5 life and after every time they died, thier life lost 1. If your life = 0, you will be turn into spectator mode.
But don't worry, you can be reborn by put an armor stand name "Dummy" or "dummy" on campfire and let someone you one to reborn be near the armor stand. But you can reborn someone you don't want to reborn so use it carefuly
